div.head: II Atr 1
div.ab: Hoc inprimis, ut pax mundi stet inter Æþelredum regem et omnem populum eius et omnem exercitum, cui rex pecuniam suam dedit, post elocutiones, quas Sigericus archiepiscopus et Æþelredus aldremannus et Ealfricus aldremannus fecerunt, postquam impetrauerunt á rege, cur possent illi partiuncule pacem emere, quam sub manu regis superhabebant.

Ðæt ærost, þæt woroldfrið stande betweox Æthelrede cynge ⁊ eallum his leodscipe ⁊ eallum ðam here, ðe se cyng þæt feoh sealde, æfter ðam formalan, ðe Sigeric arcebiscop ⁊ Æðelwerd ealdormann ⁊ Ælfric ealdorman worhton, ða hu abædon æt ðam cynge, þæt hy mostan ðam læppan frið gebicgean, ðe hy under cynge hand ofer hæfdon.

Ðæt ærost, þæt woroldfrið stande betweox Æthelrede cynge ⁊ eallum his leodscipe ⁊ eallum ðam here ðe se cyng þæt feoh sealde æfter ðam formalan ðe Sigeric arcebiscop ⁊ Æðelwerd ealdormann ⁊ Ælfric ealdorman worhton, ða h[i] abædon æt ðam cynge, þæt hy mostan ðam læppan frið gebicgean, ðe hy under cynge hand ofer hæfdon.

Das zuerst: Dass staatsrechtlicher Friede zwischen König Aethelred sammt allem seinem Volke bestehe mit dem ganzen Heere [der Nordleute], welchem der König das Geld gezahlt hat, nach den Verabredungen, welche Erzbischof Sigeric [von Canterbury] und Ealdorman Aethelweard [von Devonshire] und Ealdorman Aelfric [von Hampshire] vollzogen hatten, als sie vom König erbeten hatten, dass sie Frieden [von den Nordleuten] erkaufen dürften für die Bezirke [im südlichen und südöstlichen England], über welche sie unter dem König Gewalt hätten (des Königs Person regierten lq).

First: that there be secular peace between King Æthelred together with all his people and the whole army [of the Northmen] to which the king paid the money, according to the agreements which Archbishop Sigeric [of Canterbury] and Ealdorman Æthelweard [of Devonshire] and Ealdorman Ælfric [of Hampshire] made when they had asked the king that they might buy peace [from the Northmen] for the districts [in southern and south-eastern England] over which they had authority under the king (governed under the king's person, lq).

In the first place, a general truce shall be established between King Æthelred and all his subjects and the whole [Viking] fleet to which the king has paid tribute, in accordance with the terms which Archbishop Sigeric and Ealdorman Æthelweard and Ealdorman Ælfric made, when they obtained the king's permission to purchase peace for the districts which, subject to him, they ruled over.

Firstly, that a general peace be established between King Ethelred with all his people and all the army to which the king gave the tribute, according to the terms which Archbishop Sigeric, Ealdorman Æthelweard and Ealdorman Ælfric made, when they obtained permission from the king to purchase peace for the areas which they had rule over, under the king.
div.note: literally, “world-peace”, a unique compound. “World” as a first element may mean secular, or it may be little more than an intensitive, here contrasting this truce with those of limited application to single districts.
